name: pos
description: POS + inventory + attendance + lightweight payroll for a single retail store

scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w functions && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w functions
scripts.test:emulators: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-pos "npm run test:emulators:run"
scripts.test:emulators:run: vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts && npm run test:emu -w functions
